response.overview: Jeff is a drug peddler who wants to get away from his miserable life. Along with his friend, he plans to steal the drugs from their boss and succeeds in stealing them. After that Jeff takes the drug bag and hides in a hotel by the highway. Someone tries to break into his room and in fear, he hides inside the cupboard only to later discover that he has disappeared into another room that is identical to the one he was in. From there Jeff goes on a loop of past memories, future plans, regrets, pain, and suffering.
response.title: Recur
